conviction_note: No company-level number the market has not seen: the bar is RGP's own Q1 guide ($97-102m revenue, GM 37-38%, run-rate SG&A $41-43m), peers and the BLS temp series that spoke after 22 July lean mildly positive for On-Demand Talent and negative for consulting, and the CFO resigned effective 2 October (public since 3 September, stock already lower), so the findings sum to -0.5 while the scaled number is -0.9 (p_up 45 on a 9% absolute move) because this name has sold six of its last eight prints and the forward guide, not the quarter, is the line it trades on.
bar: Company guide for Q1 FY27 (quarter ended 2026-08-29): revenue $97-102m, gross margin 37-38%, run-rate SG&A $41-43m, given on the 2026-07-22 call (transcript https://www.webull.com/news/15273192387929088). Arithmetic of the guide implies adjusted EBITDA of roughly -$2m to -$7m. MarketBeat shows a $106.2m revenue / -$0.26 EPS consensus (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/RGP/earnings/) above the guide, which looks stale; the estimate bar is therefore disputed and findings resting on it are capped small. Sized against the guide midpoint $99.5m.
positioning_check: Short interest 2.45% of float, 2.6 days to cover, settlement 2026-09-15 (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/RGP/short-interest/, via sweep). Not crowded, so no squeeze discount on the negative. No usable option chain (ATM legs not two-sided, OI 187), so no skew and no implied move; baseline falls back to the 7.0% median historical reaction. Stock 7.5% above its 52-week low, 20-day run-up -3.6%, 6 of 8 prior reactions negative (-18.4% on 2026-07-22, -14.6% on 2026-01-07). Turnover about $1.3m a day.

findings.finding: Two staffing/consulting peers spoke after RGP's 22 July call: Robert Half (23 July) guided Talent Solutions back to about +3% y/y growth in Q3 (contract talent -1% y/y in early July, 'bottom is in') while guiding Protiviti consulting down 6% on financial-services regulatory shifts; Korn Ferry's quarter to 31 July (reported 9 Sept) grew fee revenue 7% with Workforce Solutions +11%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: RGP has traded on the forward guide: -18.4% on 2026-07-22 when the Q1 guide of $97-102m came in below a ~$106m street number, -14.6% on 2026-01-07 despite an EPS beat (MarketBeat earnings table).
findings.why_not_priced: RGP's own segments fell 14-23% y/y in the quarter to May while the staffing cycle was already turning, so the market has not been paying RGP for macro improvement; if the peer turn were priced into RGP the stock would not sit 7.5% off its 52-week low with a negative 20-day run-up. Sized net: the positive applies to On-Demand Talent (~38% of revenue), the Protiviti read is negative for Consulting (~35%), so the net is small.
findings.independence: Korn Ferry Q1 FY27 release, a different company and document: https://www.kornferry.com/about-us/press/korn-ferry-announces-first-quarter-fiscal-2027-results-of-operations (2026-09-09). Both are proxies; RGP has not confirmed the transmission.

findings.finding: BLS temporary help services employment rose 6,800 in August 2026, the eighth straight monthly gain (+1.5% y/y, +68,100 Jan-Aug), with SIA attributing professional staffing demand to previously paused projects restarting.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No instance of RGP's stock responding to the macro temp series; its revenue fell double digits through 2026 while temp help grew every month, so transmission has been weak.
findings.source_date: 2026-09 (August jobs report; page 403 to fetch, snippet_only)
findings.why_not_priced: Broad macro series is public, but RGP's guide was set on 22 July before the July and August prints of this series; if the market expected transmission RGP would have moved with staffing peers rather than drifting to near its low. Company's own number (-18% to -23% segment declines) beats this proxy, hence the small size.
findings.independence: Robert Half's Q3 Talent Solutions guide of +3% y/y points the same way (finding 1, different document): https://www.webull.com/news/15278842898686976

findings.finding: CFO Jennifer Ryu resigned effective 2 October 2026, five days before this release, with no stated reason; the interim CFO is the Chief AI Officer who joined in March 2026, and a new Chief Accounting Officer was appointed on 17 September with a guaranteed FY27 bonus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior CFO change in the baseline window; the stock fell roughly 4.46 to 3.87 in the sessions around the 3 September announcement per Yahoo daily bars (date mapping of that series approximate), so part of this is in the price.
findings.why_not_priced: The departure is public and was sold on announcement; what is not priced is how an interim finance chief with no CFO track record at RGP frames the Q2 guide and any impairment or cost charge on the call. If the market were treating it as benign the stock would have recovered toward its pre-September level rather than sitting near the 52-week low.
findings.independence: 8-K of 2026-09-21 appointing the CAO and restating the transition: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1084765/000108476526000069/rgp-20260917.htm (same event, so not independent evidence of a negative outcome).

findings.finding: MarketBeat carries a $106.2m revenue / -$0.26 EPS consensus for this print, above the company's own $97-102m guide; if any part of the street still anchors there, an in-guide print reads as a revenue miss.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2026-07-22 revenue of $106.1m against ~$106.8-107.8m consensus, in line with guide, went with -18.4% (driven by the guide below consensus).
findings.why_not_priced: Most likely stale and already disowned by holders, since the guide was public for eleven weeks; the single estimate source disagrees with the company, so the bar is disputed and this finding is capped small.
findings.independence: stockanalysis.com FY27 revenue consensus $426.4m from 3 analysts (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/RGP/forecast/) implies about $106m a quarter on average, consistent with a street that needs second-half growth above the Q1 run-rate.

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with; the mild negative lean agrees with the name's reaction history (6 of 8 down) and the 20-day drift, while the peer and macro read-throughs cut slightly against it, so p_up sits only 5 points below 50.
